invariants: separate plugin, service, operating identity, credentials, tunnel ID and rollback from Heartbeat
no arbitrary host shell; all execution passes server policy
no privileged operations through unprivileged executor
no live deployment or endpoint implementation before independent immutable-head approval
untrusted repo contents/tool outputs never confer authority
no stored or returned secrets; absence of credential access enforced by host isolation, not regex alone

heartbeat.transport: outbound OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel via tunnel-client

live_recovery_required: host identity and current process/users/group IDs
uid/gid, groups, ACLs, mounts, ownership for intended roots
actual Heartbeat PID/checkout/tunnel topology and tunnel-client compatibility
actual CI unit status, root helper APIs and rollout state
separate service port/socket and unoccupied runtime paths
SELinux/AppArmor/user namespaces/cgroup-BPF filesystem and network isolation availability
disposition of service credentials, SSH agent and network routes

transport.protocol: MCP Streamable HTTP, loopback-only service behind separate outbound Secure MCP Tunnel
transport.authentication: separate private tunnel identity; dedicated restricted runtime credential stored root-readable by tunnel-only identity, not exec uid; ChatGPT app permissioned to owner/workspace; reject unknown callers
transport.security: authenticated tunnel does not alone authorize executions; per-call task policy and capability check; no public inbound listener; deny unauthenticated local socket users; do not reuse Heartbeat tunnel, key, app or process
transport.secrets: tunnel credential never inherited by executor

tools.name: workspace_shell.inspect
tools.purpose: read-only structured, pre-approved host and repository observations

tools.name: workspace_shell.exec
tools.purpose: bounded unprivileged commands selected by typed profile, never an unrestricted executable/argv
tools.notes: Profile resolves pinned absolute executable and fully validated argv grammar; no shell -c, python -c, interpreters with arbitrary scripts, hooks, package installers, git config/aliases, or unreviewed binary paths. Any write-capable test/validation requires task-authorized scratch-only copy.

tools.name: workspace_shell.run_reviewed_helper
tools.purpose: invoke one exact, separately reviewed root helper admitted by the root-owned helper registry; never arbitrary root argv
tools.notes: Root helper registry supplies the helper-specific closed parameter schema, exact path/digest, target/task scope, declared side effects, pre/postconditions and rollback semantics. The generic MCP tool cannot nominate an executable, argv, environment, sudo flag or systemctl verb. Each new helper registry admission is a separately reviewed authority change.

tools.name: workspace_shell.receipt
tools.purpose: fetch structured, redacted execution receipt by opaque receipt ID

execution.identity: dedicated workspace-shell-exec system user, nonlogin; no supplemental groups
host_isolation: mount namespace and bind mounts for a single validated source checkout as read-only
isolated disposable scratch tmpfs, no operator home mount
not merely canonical-cwd checks: block absolute paths and symlink escapes through mount policy and descriptor-relative openat2 RESOLVE_BENEATH|RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS
no proc host process env, no Docker socket, no SSH agent, no credential directories
PrivateDevices=yes; NoNewPrivileges=yes; CapabilityBoundingSet empty; RestrictSUIDSGID=yes; ProtectSystem=strict; ProtectHome=yes; syscall and process restrictions; no writable executable paths
no outbound connectivity for ordinary exec, including GitHub; a distinct non-exec broker fetches an exact reviewed SHA
no user-provided environment overrides or executable lookup PATH

roots.source: verified isolated checkout for workspace-control, read only
roots.scratch: /var/lib/workspace-shell/jobs/<receipt-id> per execution, private, noexec where possible

limits.output_truncation: bounded bytes, count observed bytes and record truncation on each stream

execution.process_policy: fresh cgroup per request; start process group; SIGTERM then SIGKILL on timeout/cancel; cgroup.kill and inspect empty cgroup; deny daemonize/session detachment; no persistent interactive sessions in v1; long-running jobs require separate reviewed task capability
execution.caution: Even an argv-based generic Python, shell, test runner or git operation is an arbitrary code execution vector. Git reading uses hardened wrapper with hooks/config excluded; tests only in networkless disposable isolated checkout under a task-granted profile.

authorization.policy_source: immutable reviewed task capsule and signed/attested authorization digest, not GitHub comments as commands
binding: immutable independent approval for privileged operations
authorization.replay: single-use idempotency keys and durable replay journal; fail closed on missing/expired/mismatched authorization
authorization.git: resolve full 40-char commit, verify tree and checkout exact source, ensure no dirty source, verify that trust files/policy come from trusted authority not untrusted target commit; never execute repo hooks
authorization.sibling_access: explicit deny for research-engine and all sibling projects unless separately reviewed task authority

privileged_boundary.implementation: separately versioned root-owned service via Unix socket with peer credential validation and request signatures; no generic sudo policy
operations: run an exact separately reviewed helper that is already admitted by immutable root-owned helper registry for the bound task/target
inspect helper/staging metadata through non-mutating registry-defined operation
disable_workspace_shell through the dedicated emergency path
not_authorized: unregistered helper or helper digest not matching registry
workspace-control activation/reconciliation unless an independently reviewed task/helper contract explicitly authorizes that exact operation
restart research-engine cpu unless an independently reviewed task/helper contract explicitly authorizes it
preconditions: immutable reviewed design SHA and approval receipt
exact target ID and source digest
single-use nonce and bound request expiry
privileged_boundary.future_extension: New privileged capability is admitted only by changing the root-owned helper registry/policy under a separately reviewed exact Git head. Existing workspace-control owner-command maintenance authority is not implicitly transferred to Workspace Shell.

audit.storage: append-only root-owned audit store with restricted reader returning sanitized receipts; durable hash chain and log rotation
audit.redaction: reject suspect secret paths before execution, no raw /proc environ, scrub common secret output formats, no binary output; redaction is defense in depth and does not justify read access

rollback.operator_local: local root-controlled systemd stop/mask and revoke separate tunnel credential from Platform; kill service cgroup; preserve redacted receipts
rollback.dependencies: must not require Workspace Shell/Heartbeat to disable itself
rollback.staging: no live runtime mutation until review and distinct activation approval
rollback.verify: service/tunnel disconnected, socket removed, no child processes

test_plan: malicious argv separators/newlines/NUL and shell metacharacters
absolute and .. paths, symlink and openat2 race escapes
home, SSH private key, token and /proc environ denial
stdout/stderr flood, binary output and truncation counts
timeout/cancel nested children, setsid and orphan cleanup
mount/network namespace escape and privilege escalation
root helper wrong op/target, missing approval or digest mismatch
Git hooks/aliases/config injection, git alternate object paths
operator emergency shutdown while MCP unavailable
normal exact-SHA read-only workspace-control inspection, bounded isolated validation, deterministic receipt

design_notes: OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel documentation rechecked 2026-10-27: outbound-only transport, 10 MiB serialized envelope, 600 requests/minute, 120 second absolute request deadline, 1000 queued requests.
Workspace Shell uses 90 second synchronous command ceiling to retain queue/transport margin inside that 120 second absolute budget.
Tool annotations are advisory only; server-side authorization and sandboxing remain mandatory.
